source: BTS Reporting Carrier On-Time Performance, https://www.transtats.bts.gov/ (US public domain)
definition: Departure on time = left the gate less than 15 minutes late (DepDel15 = 0), among flights that were not cancelled. Arrival on time = ArrDel15 = 0. Delay causes are shares of reported delay minutes on late arrivals. Hour block = scheduled departure hour (local).
